Subject: Re: Intro + POC plan

Thanks Marissa — good convo today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can scope the trial: 

1) Success criteria: throughput of ~200 qps for our standard EHR redaction flow, latency P95 < 300ms, and no PHI leakage (we'll run a small privacy test set).
2) Evaluation plan: 2-week trial with sample data; we'll run 5000 transcripts and compare outputs to current baseline.
3) Environment options: we are open to hosted sandbox for speed, but compliance may push us to a VPC or dedicated sandbox.

Can Redwood confirm which environment is quickest to spin up for us (hosted sandbox) vs what data controls you can offer in a VPC trial? Also please share network egress/ingress requirements — our infra team will need that.

Thanks — Sara
Sr. Product Manager | Acme Health

Subject: Re: POC / Trial environment setup — hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC

Hi Sara / Tom — thanks for the clear success criteria. Quick responses and proposal so we can lock timelines: 

- Hosted sandbox: fastest to spin up (48 hours). Shared environment, data encrypted in transit and at rest; for PHI we recommend tokenization on your side during the test. No dedicated IPs.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved pool): 3–5 business days to provision, isolated GPU pool, per-tenant logs, better throughput guarantees and easier to reproduce production-like performance.
- VPC trial (customer-managed networking): ~10 business days because we need subnet peering and firewall rules; supports customer KMS and stricter audit log controls.

Proposal: start with a 2-week hosted sandbox pilot next week to validate functional outputs and success criteria 1 (quality). Parallel prep for a dedicated sandbox if the baseline signals look good; move to VPC if legal requires PHI handling in customer network.

Next steps / owners: 
- Redwood to provide network_requirements.pdf and setup checklist (owner: Rishi) — target: 2026-05-31
- Acme to share sample anonymized dataset and baseline metrics (owner: Sara) — target: 2026-06-01
- Redwood to provision hosted sandbox and give creds (owner: Marissa) — target: 2026-06-02
- Kickoff call to start trial and orient evaluation plan (owner: Vivek) — target: 2026-06-03

I've attached a draft success criteria doc for your review. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the requirements.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC / Trial environment setup — network + infra checklist

Hi team — attaching the infra checklist and a short network_requirements.pdf (stub) with the minimal ports, IPs and expected egress ranges. A few clarifications: 

- For hosted sandbox the only requirement is outbound TLS to our region endpoints; no inbound.
- For dedicated sandbox we will provide a static egress IP and an SSH jump host for debugging if you want it enabled.
- For VPC peering we require: one subnet for peering, a NAT gateway for outbound egress, and the ability to accept our peering prefix. We will share exact CIDRs once you confirm.

I'll coordinate with your infra team directly once Sara confirms an internal contact and the preferred environment.

Cheers,
